BiblicalUsage: Zerubbabel led the first exiles home from Babylon and set the temple's foundations again with Jeshua the priest. The Aramaic spelling of his name appears in Ezra's account of the rebuilding, where the two men rise up together and build. His full story lives on his People profile.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Zerubbabel's work is the pattern of every return: God brings His people home, and the rebuilding starts with worship. The temple rose because God stirred the leaders first.
